steps.title: Prepare Equipment and Racks
steps.instruction: Precool 96-well microfuge tube racks on ice to maintain the cold chain and prevent RNA degradation.

steps.title: Label Microfuge Tubes
steps.instruction: Label 1.5 mL microfuge tubes with unique sample IDs using permanent markers or preprinted adhesive labels.

steps.title: Transfer Fecal Samples
steps.instruction: Transfer fecal samples into the corresponding pre-labeled 1.5 mL microfuge tubes and place them sequentially onto the chilled microfuge tube rack.

steps.title: Label and Store Sample Racks
steps.instruction: Once the rack is full or all samples are completed, secure the rack and move to long-term storage.

substeps.instruction: Label the rack with a unique rack ID.
Close the rack lid tightly and secure it with clear saran wrap.
Immediately transfer the rack to a -80 °C freezer.

steps.title: Log Storage Location
steps.instruction: Enter the storage location in the REDI-NET Data Portal using the Sample Storage tab, referring to the Guidance on REDI-NET Sample Storage Time QRG.

steps.title: Transfer Extracted Total Nucleic Acid
steps.instruction: In a clean PCR workstation, transfer eluted total nucleic acid (from a 96-well microplate Flex model or elution strip Duo Prime model) to a 96-well PCR microplate while keeping samples on ice.

substeps.instruction: Maintain exact sample locations (e.g., A1 to A1, A2 to A2) corresponding to the original fecal sample rack.
Mark the 'A1' position on the 96-well microplate to ensure correct plate orientation.

steps.title: Seal and Store Nucleic Acid Plate
steps.instruction: Seal the 96-well PCR microplate and transfer it to the freezer.

substeps.instruction: Cover the plate with adhesive film to prevent spill over or contamination.
Label the film with a unique plate ID.
Immediately transfer the plate to a -80 °C freezer.
